objective: 保留现有训练与评测能力，精简重复代码和内部层级

changes.result: 移除五个已无生产调用的私有转发模块，调用与测试指向现有职责归属。
两条启动链共用运行生命周期；普通 runs inspect 可读取 launcher 记录；配置准备失败、真实工作进程退出和中断信号统一落盘。
两种复现配方共享验证逻辑，保留各自命名空间、检查点格式与 SHA 验证。
MotionSDK、Weave、Microduck 复用现有有界复制与校验；保留源与目标变更检测。逻辑读取减少不作为实测性能提升。
Core 与 H1 复用现有 learning 层中的 MLP 构造，层序、参数名、随机数分配顺序和优化器格式不变。
现有架构集中于 docs/architecture.md，旧地址保留链接，移除未实现接口草案与重复解释。
不再在源发布包内嵌历史证据压缩包，仓库原件保留。实际归档成员差异仅为25个历史包及5个退役模块。

public_core_evaluation.scope: Original pre-refactor core checkpoint,37real steps with compact asynchronous recording, through baseline/candidate/installed-wheel public evaluate entry. Not a new robot training run.

physical_checks.scope: Reference-informed thresholds on current mjlab G1, with conservative fixed-window/200Hzgeometry/model-identity checks. One evaluation does not establish independent-training robustness or exact IsaacLab3V14 reproduction.

rejected_candidates.reason: Core rollout permits assignment/broadcast/cast semantics for extra reset observations; the shared borrowed-environment evaluator requires exact reset schema. Merging via current API changes4tested behaviors or adds a new mode/adapter, contrary to subtraction goal.

Go1 task/learner are replayed from a standalone frozen package. An absolute shared-constructor dependency would escape that recorded source boundary. Retain its small local builder; Core/H1 already depend on the common learning layer.

registry.selection: Actual last checkpoint of a completed full-width reference-recipe run; not selected by return

scope_limits: 本轮是架构与发布精简，没有重新训练或声称提升策略成功率。
G1复测为现有mjlab资产与移植阈值下的模拟验收；不构成真机测试、独立训练鲁棒性或IsaacLab3V14严格等价证明。
可选依赖缺失对应的跳过项保留在测试XML；两套环境结果分别报告。
